text:
I've been here many times, but I strongly advise against it. Go somewhere else, because this will be my last visit. There are so many doctors, and they're rarely the same one. The treatment isn't very good, and it's a complete waste of time. The counter staff are rude, refuse cases, and even turn people down when they're already there, telling them to go back to their usual clinic. If you're looking for a backup hospital in case your regular clinic is unavailable, I highly don't recommend this place.

However, if you plan to continue using their services, I recommend memorizing your child's symptoms because the doctors are almost always different. Every time you go, they ask the same questions, even though they likely have the patient's history. It's a huge waste of time and money. I definitely don't recommend it.

restaurant_name: โรงพยาบาลสัตว์แฮปปี้
text: The doctor is kind, and the assistants are very kind and gentle with the children. The costs are also reasonable, not expensive at all. If you're on a tight budget, you can consult with the doctor first. This place is great! I love it here. Taro recovered quickly because we brought him for treatment here. ❤️❤️

restaurant_name: โรงพยาบาลสัตว์แฮปปี้
text: It's cheaper than other places. If you only need it for vaccinations, I recommend it. But if you need treatment, one visit is enough. We took our cat there for a full month to treat a wound and spent a lot of money. The wound was quite deep and located in a joint crease, so it heals slower than other areas, which I understand. But what I found most unacceptable was that there were multiple vets. Each time we took the cat for wound cleaning, they changed vets, and each vets bandaged the wound differently. Some bandaged tightly, others very loosely; there was absolutely no standardization. Each time we went, the vets didn't explain anything; we had to ask questions constantly. Especially the tall female vet with glasses, she was incredibly arrogant, giving only curt answers. Most recently, she bandaged the wound so tightly that our cat's paw swelled excessively. We took the cat back to the clinic and had to pay again... That's it. We've gone to other places that are more expensive but provide better care, attention, and proper bandaging.

The price of the ultrasound is quite high, so I recommend planning the steps carefully.

text: My younger sibling had blood in their urine. I took them to the same clinic for treatment and they showed me their previous medical history. They told me to do it again because the images weren't clear. The blood test and urine test came back the same. They didn't give me any medicine except for the blood thinner. I was wondering why they didn't give me the anti-inflammatory medicine. The blood was still there. They made an appointment for an X-ray. The next day, they said I needed an ultrasound too. They gave me medicine to stop the bleeding again. A week later, they drew blood to check the symptoms again. They told me to do dialysis. It might be related to the dialysis or inflammation, but the blood still hadn't stopped when I urinated. I called and they said the doctor was busy. I paid two or three times and didn't get anything. I'm very confused. They only gave me an X-ray, blood test, and no anti-inflammatory medicine. I called and they were busy. I saw my lower lip and thought I was having a fever. I'm scared.
